verdict.rationale: Zero is described as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox. This is backed by documented AI tools for asking questions about mailbox content and threads and for AI-assisted composing. The in-product insight features rest mainly on a founder description and terse MCP tool lists rather than in-depth first-party docs. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the in-app summarization and insight UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
